name: K.P. Energy Ltd
title: K.P. Energy Ltd - 539686 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~126% to Rs 521 cr but gross margin fell to ~20% from 28% in Q4; order book cut to Rs 2,250 cr and FY27 growth guided to 30-40%, with no margin guidance.

triggers.label: Gross margin 28% → ~20% QoQ
triggers.quote: A gross margin in Q1 FY27 was approximately 20% compared with that at 28% in Q4 FY26.

triggers.label: FY27 top-line growth cut to 30-40%
triggers.quote: we would like to stay at about 30% to 40% as a guiding number

triggers.label: Order book Rs 3,000 cr → Rs 2,250 cr
triggers.quote: we have executed about 500 crores of business this quarter, that leaves about 2500.

triggers.label: Order book ~50% related party
triggers.quote: about 50% is related party and the balance 50% is non-related

guidance.quote: we would like to stay at about 30% to 40% as a guiding number
Right. We expect 100, yes. You can expect 100.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we would like to stay at about 30% to 40% as a guiding number

red_flags.label: Margin collapse and related-party order mix
red_flags.quote: about 50% is related party and the balance 50% is non-related

red_flags.label: Possible order de-scoping
red_flags.quote: whether we should continue with the same business, or should we take a call on de-scoping our existing order in hand

red_flags.label: Evasion on margin outlook
red_flags.quote: it will not be right at this very moment to give you a number

evasions.quote: it will not be right at this very moment to give you a number
your suggestion in terms of when we publish the order intake, we do not publish the value
I cannot give you a generalized answer on it

summary.headline: K.P. Energy Q1 FY27 total income rose ~126% YoY to Rs 520.97 crore, but gross margin fell to ~20% from 28% in Q4 FY26.
